defects.title: bound-measure validation is skipped on the positive court path
implementation: pre553_temporal_comparability.py:858 parses quantity_surface.measure_ref with _require_ref, which accepts ExactRef
the resulting integrity exception is caught and converted to measure_ref=None
pre553_temporal_comparability.py:862-864 compares only when parsed measure_ref is non-null
pre553_temporal_comparability.py:868-873 serializes the valid AuthorityRef fixture as measure_ref=null
defects.court_gap: The mismatch witness supplies a different ExactRef, while the positive fixture supplies an AuthorityRef, so the witness does not prove the valid-path binding.
defects.impact: A directional delta can be minted without an exact bound measure on the quantity surface.

defects.title: missing required temporal_order_basis_ref does not map to the accepted insufficient-authority terminal
defects.accepted_law: authorized disposition + missing basis ref -> TEMPORAL_INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY / TEMPORAL_ORDER_BASIS_AUTHORITY_REF_ABSENT
defects.observed_control_flow: basis absence is not detected; _validate_receipt_cross_field_law later raises TemporalComparabilityIntegrityError

defects.title: partial-order disposition overrides higher-priority terminal states with an exception
defects.implementation: pre553_temporal_comparability.py:943-948 raises unless any PARTIAL_ORDER_NO_DIRECTION request ends in one of the two comparable-no-direction states
defects.counterexample: PARTIAL_ORDER_NO_DIRECTION + unresolved identity first selects TEMPORAL_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED, then raises
defects.impact: The advertised total relation-state precedence is not total for partial-order requests; mandatory terminal comparability semantics cannot be emitted.

no_basis_precedence.with_higher_failure: higher-priority state emitted and no_basis_observation retained

exact_zero.law: exact signed difference == canonical numeric zero only
